collection.title: Toyota C-HR 2016 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Toyota C-HR 2016 - 2023 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this C-HR which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
